claims.statement: HEADLINE HYPOTHESIS FAILED: on this corpus the handoff capsule did not improve cold-reader accuracy (4/4 traps found by both arms) and did not cause laundering (0/4).

Four isolated cold-reader trials actually executed (this was NOT_RUN in the prior round's design) with an executable oracle deriving ground truth by running the source rather than trusting any agent report.

The run's own booster v1 falsely flagged BOTH capsule trials as laundering, at a 100% false-positive rate on correct agents that were quoting a defective hash in order to REFUTE it. Fixed to inspect structured claim fields only, with a regression case added.
Booster self-test discriminates: perfect-passes, blind-fails, forged-hash-fails and prose-refutation-not-flagged all hold.
Oracle self-check passes 4/4 traps plus control; all four planted declared-vs-actual traps confirmed by execution.
Every planted value-contract violation type-checks CLEAN under tsc 7.0.2 --strict; only type-level violations (arity, void return) are caught at compile time.

EXECUTION IS UNVERIFIABLE from the artifacts: all four answers self-report executed:true and the oracle verifies what the code DOES, not what any agent DID. This is the run's central limitation and is not fixable within this design.

Capsule recall on real repo source is unresolved. The corpus was two toy files; the informative signal came from the handoff artifact's own defects, not the source. Any capsule-helps conclusion would be unsupported.

Four cold readers are four contexts of ONE model family; their agreement is not independent corroboration. n=2 per arm, so no statistical claim is supportable and the baseline arm's internal token spread (15k-42k) exceeds the between-arm gap.

competencies_not_probed.value: retrieving dependencies; asking peers for missing knowledge

publication.reason: Run note, capability pack with computed hashes, four raw cold-reader answers, oracle, booster and evidence receipts.

extensions.independence: INDEPENDENCE VIOLATION, SELF-DISCLOSED. A stray `head -60` of arm B's run note occurred before arm D authored its traps. Exposure was to Run B's fixture results only; the four cold readers were sealed and unaffected. The lead's framing of the experiment is partially informed.
extensions.decision_1_feeder: pinned fixture (custody verified by digest) plus a file this run authored; real cohort not used
extensions.decision_2_automation: Phase 0 toolkits not invoked — recorded as an UNUSED AUTOMATION OPPORTUNITY, not a finding that they are unsuitable
extensions.decision_3_signal: OBSERVED_DISCREPANCY, but the discrepancy is CLAIM-vs-VERIFIABILITY rather than machine-vs-human
extensions.booster_count_disclosure: Three programs written where one booster was permitted. The run states its own reading (oracle = referee apparatus, publish-pack = mandatory publication machinery) and flags the risk rather than hiding it.
extensions.proposed_new_behavior: E11 — distinguish a HANDOFF CLAIM from a SELF-GAINED WITNESS. Proposed because every arm's central evidence is self-asserted and therefore unfalsifiable from the artifact alone.
